topics.label: Lecture Introduction and Learning Objectives
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer welcomes students to the final lecture of the course and outlines the learning objectives regarding cancer treatment approaches and their modes of action.

topics.label: Conventional Modalities and Cytotoxic Chemotherapy
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics discuss standard cancer treatment modalities—including physical debulking and cytotoxic agents—along with the physiological toxicity and efflux-mediated drug resistance they provoke.

topics.label: Exploiting Intrinsic Cancer Cell Vulnerabilities and DNA Repair Defects
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine strategies that exploit intrinsic cancer vulnerabilities, such as hormone receptor signaling dependencies, cell cycle checkpoint losses, and defective DNA damage repair pathways.

topics.label: Kinase Inhibitors, Resistance, and Drug Addiction
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore the development of targeted kinase inhibitors for oncogene-driven cancers and detail the molecular mechanisms through which tumor cells develop drug resistance and addiction.

topics.label: Monoclonal Antibodies and Antibody-Drug Conjugates
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe how engineered monoclonal antibodies and antibody-toxin conjugates target cell-surface antigens to direct cytotoxic effects against tumor cells.

topics.label: Tumor Immune Surveillance and Checkpoint Inhibitors
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore the evidence for immune surveillance against cancer and explain how immune checkpoint blockade reactivates T-cell responses against tumor neoantigens.

topics.label: Engineered Cellular and Bispecific Immunotherapies
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe synthetic immunotherapy strategies that redirect or engineer T cells to target specific tumor antigens, focusing on bispecific T-cell engagers and chimeric antigen receptor T cells.

topics.label: Challenges, Progress, and Future Directions in Oncology
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics review the systemic challenges, epidemiological progress, ethical considerations, and emerging paradigms shaping the future of cancer therapy.
